## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Equity strength (SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +5.13%), QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +10.00%)) is offset by broadly neutral risk ratios (VXX NEUTRAL; SPY_TLT NEUTRAL), and pockets of sector weakness (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%)), supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.74% | 1M: -13.93%) ↓ falling. Credit broadly neutral: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +0.15%) → flat and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.36%) ↑ rising. Equity leadership concentrated in Tech and Semis: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-mildly accommodative: TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -1.49%) ↑ rising and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.36%) ↑ rising — duration flows mixed but not decisively tightening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech and semis leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) showing strength; cyclicals mixed with Financials positive at the sector level (Financials 1W: +1.00% | 1M: +0.86%) while Energy lags: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%). Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities robust: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +5.13%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +10.00%); Emerging Markets also strong: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +7.31%), but China lagging: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -3.01%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +5.01%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +0.95%) showing risk-on flows; Bitcoin exposure weak: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -2.34%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial metals firm: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +5.66%) ↑ rising. Gold under pressure: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -4.44%) ↓ falling; silver in CORRECTION (SLV CORRECTION (1W: -0.31% | 1M: +1.35%)).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy in short-term pullback: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%), BNO CORRECTION (1W: -7.89% | 1M: +0.97%), and UNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.46% | 1M: +5.82%) — momentum fading despite mixed 1M profiles.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/Semis (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%)) are strong across both windows. DIVERGENCE: TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -1.49%) and several commodities in CORRECTION are 1W/1M mismatches — minor divergence, market appears transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure via tech and semis (XLK, SOXX) while reducing exposure to lagging Energy (XLE) and gold (GLD); bonds neutral-to-watch (TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -1.49%), LQD RECOVERY (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.36%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%); Semiconductors — SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%). BEARISH: Energy — XLE CORRECTION (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%); Precious metals — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -4.44%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper — CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +5.66%). BEARISH: Brent/Crude and NatGas on pullbacks — BNO CORRECTION (1W: -7.89% | 1M: +0.97%), UNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.46% | 1M: +5.82%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD divergence around 0.80 (credit health monitor); XLK vs XLF relative spread (watch for sustained outperformance); SPY momentum support at recent 1M uptrend band.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but key risk ratios and cycle signals are flat, producing a neutral regime. Tech and Semis (XLK, SOXX) are showing relative strength while Energy (XLE) and Gold (GLD) remain key divergences to monitor.
